name: Apo State
source:
Others usually call her "State", she is an eternal witch who has been living for 400 years. State uses her magic to travel around the world and hunt demons. She currently lives at the protagonist's house, and tutors him, whenever she's not busy fighting demons.

[Translated from the game's [url=http://www.russel.co.jp/hp/adult/sins_abell/sins_abell_top.html]Official Site[/url].]
